title: FrozenQuestion
description: ADR 0008 Axis 1 — the formal question object the construct-adversary is funded against. Its DEFINING property is authorship separation: it is pinned from a PRE-construction artifact (grilling) before the production/construction loop, so the proposer (the construction) did not author it and cannot restate or modify it. 'construction is close to the question' is then a claim about a referent outside the construction's control.

formal_statement.description: The question as a formal object: a decision the operator faces, stated so that a world either satisfies it or not. NOT the construction's claim — the question the construction must answer.

true_iff.description: The condition under which the frozen question's answer is YES. The construct-adversary uses this to label each tested world's true answer independently of whether the construction's measurement passes there.

decision_context.description: Why the operator cares — the real decision riding on the answer.

source_artifact.description: Where the question was frozen FROM. Must be a pre-construction source (grilling) or operator-pinned — never the construction itself.

source_provenance.description: Hash / pin of the source artifact at freeze time, so a later construction cannot silently re-author the question.

frozen_at_phase.description: Freeze happens at production entry, before any construction node runs.
